_comment: C0-12 coze bodies EN. 无附加小节。正文「相关条目」1 行带 .md 链接（Dify），related 写 1 条。

axes.model_access: The domestic Coze official homepage names "free model switching: Doubao-Seed / Kimi / GLM / Minimax, native support for the latest domestic models"; the international coze.com model catalog has not been verified item by item. The platform ships no model of its own; switching happens in the app configuration.
axes.runtime: Cloud-hosted form: apps are built on the Coze platform and run on ByteDance's cloud; official docs list publishing channels (Feishu/WeChat/Douyin/Doubao/stores etc.). No official statement of a self-hosted form (unknown means unknown).
axes.local_files: Knowledge bases/databases/object storage are hosted by the platform (official docs: managed structured and unstructured data solutions); the Coze coding line provides a cloud sandbox (filesystem/terminal/preview). The local machine hosts no runtime.
axes.background: Official homepage framing: Coze agents are "fully online continuously, with cloud phones/cloud PCs, long-term memory that understands you better the more you use them, and tasks advanced autonomously" — cloud-resident is the flagship official form.
axes.tools: Plugins/workflows/skills are the official trio; official docs list external integrations (Feishu messaging, WeChat, Volcengine Ark etc.); the domestic homepage says local Claude Code / Codex CLI / Openclaw can be connected in one click.
axes.context: The official homepage claims long-term memory and project-asset accumulation (each project has its own storage space); memory-mechanism details not verified item by item.
axes.permissions: Spaces/workspaces are the official organizational boundary (space admins configure external integrations); enterprise-edition details not verified item by item. Data sits on ByteDance's cloud — the official statement on domestic data staying domestic has not been verified item by item.
axes.fit: Fits: agent building with direct reach into domestic distribution chains (WeChat/Douyin/Feishu), free switching among domestic models, zero-deployment start. Does not fit: self-hosting to control data; source-level control (belongs to framework).

runs: This site has not completed measured runs. The closest test protocol is the code-side [protocols/framework/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/framework/_protocol.md) (the tool-calling and credential-boundary sections are reusable; no workflow-platform-specific protocol exists on this site yet).
unknowns:
- The international coze.com model catalog (not verified item by item)
- Mechanism details of long-term memory and "project-asset accumulation"
- Self-hosted form (no official statement — treated as "unknown", not "officially not allowed")
- The relationship between Coze and Doubao's filing entries (the reason the cn block marks unknown)
related: Both Chinese-origin agent-building platforms: Dify can be self-hosted, Coze is cloud-hosted — where the data lands is the core divide.
